question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"within."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The reason to use **"within"** in this context is to convey the timeframe during which the action occurs. (इस संदर्भ में **"within"** का उपयोग करने का कारण उस समय सीमा को बताना है जिसके दौरान कार्रवाई होती है।)
 
• **"Within" **indicates a specific time frame, suggesting that the symptoms of metal allergies can start to manifest shortly after putting earrings in your ears.
 
• It helps specify the relatively short period in which the reaction may occur.
 
• The correct answer is option 2.

 

Correct paragraph: 

Metal allergies can begin to act up **within**__ minutes of putting earrings in your ears. Some people can go a few hours before having to ______ (2) ______ the earrings out, but some can barely stand the ______ (3) ______ enough to bother putting earrings in at all. This can be discouraging for those of us ______ (4) ______ love to wear earrings, but fortunately hypoallergenic jewellery for ______ (5) ______ ears exists! 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **With: **in the company of somebody/something; in or to the same place as somebody/something. ((व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु) के पास; (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु) के साथ)
 
• **About: **a little more or less than; approximately. (लगभग)
 
• **Of: **belonging to, connected with, or part of something/somebody. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के स्‍वामित्‍ववाला, से संबंधित या उसका भाग; का)
